title: The whole upstairs
description: Both new bathrooms sit at the rear. The three bedrooms, chimney, stairs and window openings remain in place.

title: Straight down
description: Furniture and new walls at the same scale. Front of the house is left; driveway side is at the top.

title: The primary suite
description: A compact reach-in beside the chimney and shallow drawers opposite the queen replace the former walk-in closet.

title: From the landing
description: The hall bath opens directly off the landing through a nominal 32-inch pocket doorway.

title: From the hall into the primary
description: The linen cabinet is gone. The open hall corner leads to the primary bedroom.

title: Hall bath: at the door
description: A 24-inch vanity, toilet and 60 × 30-inch tub fit in the revised room.

title: Hall bath: looking back
description: The vanity and entry relationship, with the pocket door fully retracted.

title: Hall bath: the tub
description: The retained window falls within the tub surround; its glazing and waterproofing need construction detailing.

title: Primary: entering the room
description: The existing spindle bed and both nightstands move together 7 inches toward the side window. Their sizes and bedside gaps stay unchanged.

title: Primary: drawers and shelving
description: 54 inches of shallow storage beyond the rear windows. The existing bed leaves about 30.2 inches to the closed drawer handles; an open drawer reduces that aisle.

title: Primary: toward the new bath
description: The ensuite pocket entry is tucked into the new wall, just before the first rear-window casing.

title: Ensuite: at the entrance
description: The shower sits to the left and the toilet beyond the pocket entry. The room is approximately 6 × 7 feet.

title: Ensuite: looking back
description: The 30-inch-wide vanity is shallow to preserve movement between the shower and bedroom doorway.

title: Ensuite: shower and vanity
description: A 36 × 52-inch shower with fixed glass and an outward-opening door. A low curb is shown.

title: Primary: the chimney-side closet
description: 42 inches of double-hanging storage with sliding fronts. One panel is parked open to reveal the storage.

title: Hall bath: pocket door closed
description: The door retracts toward the driveway wall. There is no linen cabinet alongside it.
